timeout_policy: Every target's timeout_seconds is at least 2x its measured full-command baseline: the sum of its test files' CI wall times in ci/test-durations.json (full-suite JUnit, instrumented, so an upper bound), enforced by tests/ci/test_mutation_gate.py (okengine#895). Confirmation and fallback runs execute the full test_command under this timeout; coverage-guided selection runs only the tests covering a mutated line, capped at half of it (okengine#900). Raise a timeout by re-deriving it from re-recorded durations, never by hand.

runtime_costs.selected_basis: okengine#940: the cost of a whole-file campaign under coverage-guided selection, for the budget pre-check and for choosing each target's mode. Each value is its worker_seconds scaled by the ratio of two campaigns measured on ONE host at d26f00481f with that commit's full-suite-combine map (job 136032), same shard plan (2 x 4 workers), run back to back 2026-09-29/30: every critical target selected (16818 s wall) and on its full test_command (19879 s wall). A value at or above worker_seconds means selection measured slower, so that target runs its full test_command. patches/cron-plus/* are absent: the map records no test executing them, so they always run their full test_command. corpus_transaction, reid_sources_by_url and several write services gained test files after d26f00481f;
